# Change the default workbench idle culling timeout from 24 hours to 8 hours

## Description

This epic changes the shipped default idle culling timeout for workbench
(notebook server) culling from 24 hours to 8 hours, so that newly installed
clusters stop abandoned workbenches after 8 hours of inactivity without an
administrator having to find and change the setting. The culling setting, its
`notebook-controller-culler-config` ConfigMap, and the Dashboard administration
UI already exist; only the shipped default value changes. Existing clusters
that have an explicitly configured culling timeout are not changed on upgrade.

## Scope

- Change the default idle culling timeout value from 24 hours to 8 hours in the
  shipped defaults for the notebook-controller culler (Notebooks component).
- Ensure the Dashboard administration surface for culling configuration
  (OdhDashboardConfig notebookController settings) reflects the new default
  where the default is surfaced (e.g., displayed placeholder/default value in
  the cluster-settings UI), so admins see the value that now ships by default.
- Preserve existing behavior on upgrade: clusters with an explicitly configured
  culling timeout are not modified; only new installs (and clusters relying on
  the default) get 8 hours.
- Update the release note and the cluster-settings documentation to state the
  new default and how to override it (no new content authored beyond stating
  the new default and override instructions — falls out of this change).

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Given** a newly installed cluster with no explicit culling configuration,
  **when** a workbench is idle for 8 hours, **then** it is stopped by the idle
  culler — measured by a fresh-install test where the effective culling
  timeout is 8 hours.
- **Given** a cluster upgraded from a previous release with an explicitly
  configured idle culling timeout, **when** the upgrade completes, **then** the
  explicitly configured value is unchanged — measured by an upgrade test
  comparing the configured timeout before and after.
- **Given** the Dashboard cluster-settings culling configuration UI, **when**
  an administrator views the idle culling timeout setting, **then** the default
  value shown matches the new 8-hour shipped default.
- The release note and cluster-settings documentation state that the default
  idle culling timeout is 8 hours and describe how to override it.
- No changes to activity detection (kernel probe behavior) or per-project /
  per-user culling policies.

## HLR Traceability

- **HLR-1** (P1): default idle culling timeout for newly installed clusters is
  8 hours; existing explicitly configured clusters unchanged on upgrade —
  covered by this epic.
- **HLR-2** (P2): release note and cluster-settings documentation state the new
  default and how to override it — covered by this epic (incidental doc update
  falling out of the same change; no substantive new content authored).
